curve-ball-3d.title: Curve Ball 3D - Free Online Arcade Sports Game
curve-ball-3d.slogan: Challenge Your Skills in Neon Tennis Matches
curve-ball-3d.description: Curve Ball 3D offers an addictive arcade experience where you curve and hit the ball to defeat skilled opponents. In this first-person tennis game, aim for the highest score in a limited neon space. Each round starts with 3,000 points, decreasing over time—win faster to score higher! With only five attempts per round, focus and adapt to unpredictable balls. Ready to test your reflexes? Play Curve Ball 3D now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Curve Ball 3D is an addictive arcade sports game where you curve and hit the ball to defeat skilled opponents in a neon tennis match. Aim for the highest score by adapting to unpredictable balls and increasing difficulty.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Move the mouse to direct the racket to the ball position and press the key to serve.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Observe the ball's direction to control the containment shield and block the opponent's attack.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Score points by hitting the ball in places where the opponent cannot block it.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Each round starts with 3,000 points, decreasing over time—win faster to score higher!
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: The pace of the game increases with each level, challenging your focus and reflexes.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: You only have five attempts per round to block misses, adding to the challenge.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Experience first-person tennis in a limited neon space with attractive sports gameplay.
